scope: Detect repeated ordinary HEADER variable records and repeated group codes within one HEADER variable while keeping tolerant parse behavior.
Refuse HEADER rewrite/publication until the caller explicitly repairs or accepts the final value; preserve refusal state across copy and move.
Audit documented HEADER object-reference variables against the official Autodesk table and confirm existing dedicated retention/graph-remap paths cover them.

source.title: Autodesk HEADER Section Group Codes (DXF)
source.use: Confirms HEADER CEPSNID group 390 and VisualStyle references INTERFEREOBJVS 345, INTERFEREVPVS 346, and DRAGVS 349; HANDSEED group 5 is a next-available handle rather than an object-reference edge.

tests: Generated ASCII/Binary controls cover one unique HEADER variable, a duplicate variable record, and a repeated group value.
Malformed sources remain readable and expose the last parsed value, but cannot be directly serialized or exported through the adapter until explicit replacement/acknowledgment.
Refusal survives copy/move, preserves a sentinel destination, and a same-adapter retry succeeds after repair.
validation: git diff --check on touched implementation/test/plan files: PASS

limitations: Unknown HEADER variable preservation and unsupported compound field shapes remain open; this change only prevents repeated-group last-value normalization from being silently rewritten.
No persistent drawing fixture, full suite, independent producer/native acceptance, or support-claim promotion was added.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; FreeCAD Linux/Windows and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic qualification remain open.
